term.name: streamed_iteration
term.definition: An xsl:iterate, or an xsl:for-each-group whose groups form as the nodes pass, whose select is a downward path of a streamed body, lowered to a chain of STREAM expressions whose last folds the iteration states: each selected node, in its full window, is given to the iteration's closure as it passes, and a break ends the reading (internal, src/xslt_lower_stream.c, )
